findings.issue: Module-level log() calls datetime.now() directly instead of going through the injected clock, technically violating contract rule 2 ('no datetime.now() outside client/clock/sleeper').
findings.fix: Harmless as-is because the backtest monkey-patches strat.log to use sim time and log() output is display-only, not used in decision logic; could be made clock-aware for consistency but not required.
